items.title: 구찌, 머라이어 캐리와 함께한 홀리데이 시즌 기프트 캠페인 공개
items.summary: Gucci released its 2026 holiday gift campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around her Christmas anthem. The campaign introduces the new Starlet handbag line (shoulder, Boston, bucket, tote variants) and a Butterfly special collection referencing Carey's 1997 album; the Butterfly pieces go on pre-sale via Gucci's official online store from Nov 2 and reach physical stores mid-November.

items.title: グッチ「GucciCore Pop-Up ショップ」が伊勢丹新宿店にオープン
items.summary: Gucci opened a GucciCore pop-up at Isetan Shinjuku (Nov 4-10) to mark a Japan-limited women's bag launch, including a new Gucci NY tote (small size Japan-exclusive), tying into the brand's New York-themed GucciCore campaign rolling out across Japanese stores and the official online store through November.

items.title: Everyone in China recognizes Gucci. That's the problem
items.summary: Critical analysis arguing that after 15 years of running a brand-recognition business in China, Gucci's near-universal name recognition has become a liability rather than an asset in 2026 as price cuts and store closures fail to win back disengaged Chinese shoppers who now view the brand as generic rather than desirable.

items.title: ケリング株が一時16%超の急落、第3四半期の「グッチ」の売上低迷と再建への不透明感
items.summary: Kering shares fell more than 16% intraday after Q3 2026 results showed Gucci sales down 6% comparable (EUR 1.291bn), dragging total group revenue to EUR 3.345bn (-1% comparable). Kering closed 128 stores and opened 23 in the first nine months, already exceeding its full-year 100-store net-reduction target, but markets read this as confirmation the turnaround is not yet working.

items.title: Kering: Q3 revenue remains stable as jewelry and eyewear offset Gucci contraction
items.summary: Kering's Q3 2026 revenue held flat at EUR 3.35bn only because Jewelry (+11% comparable, Boucheron strong in South Korea and Japan) and Eyewear (+4%) offset a 9% comparable drop in Gucci's directly-operated retail sales, which Kering explicitly attributed to lower store traffic in mainland China and Japan. CEO Luca de Meo called Gucci's recovery the group's defining priority.

items.title: 루이비통·구찌 사던 중국 부자들 어디 갔나…세금 추징에 럭셔리업계 비상
items.summary: Report on wealthy Chinese consumers pulling back from Louis Vuitton and Gucci purchases amid intensified Chinese tax authority scrutiny of offshore assets of high earners, compounding an already-weak luxury demand environment and pushing some spending toward domestic Chinese luxury brands instead.

items.title: 중국 명품 소비, 수입보다 '신토불이'로…LVMH·구찌 매출 급락
items.summary: Analysis of Chinese consumers rotating spending from imported luxury houses like LVMH and Gucci toward homegrown Chinese luxury brands (Songmont, Laopu Gold, Mao Geping), driven by property-market weakness, youth unemployment and softened consumer sentiment plus tighter offshore-asset taxation for high earners.

items.title: 구찌와 함께한 리노 x 하퍼스바자 화보 공개
items.summary: Stray Kids' official X account posted Lee Know's Harper's Bazaar Korea cover shoot wearing Gucci's 2026 Cruise collection, tagged #Gucci #구찌; part of fandom amplification of Lee Know's role as Gucci global brand ambassador.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、关店105家、业绩承压，3个维度说清
items.summary: Weibo explainer post summarizing Gucci's recent turbulence for Chinese readers: Demna's debut collection, a net reduction of 105 stores globally year-to-date, and continued earnings pressure, framed around Kering's Q3 2026 results and the roughly 16% intraday stock drop.

items.title: 古驰保值吗？2026年真实回收数据：最高72%的只有这3款
items.summary: Weibo secondhand-market explainer citing November 2026 resale data: Gucci's average bag retention/resale value is roughly 42%, well below Hermes and Chanel and also below LV (70-80%); only classic styles like the 1955 Horsebit and Jackie 1961 hold 58-72%, while trend/influencer styles resell at 20-30% of retail, some new-season pieces dropping below 50% within three months of launch.

items.title: [다시, 보기] 구찌는 왜 경복궁을 고집했나…역설의 배설
items.summary: Korean community (theqoo) thread discussing, retrospectively and critically, Gucci's insistence on holding its Cosmogonie show at Gyeongbokgung Palace despite controversy, framing the choice as a paradox between cultural-heritage respect and commercial branding; comment sentiment in the thread leans skeptical of the brand's motives.

items.title: 더쿠 - 천원짜리 숏드라마 같다는 중국 구찌 칠석 캠페인
items.summary: Korean community thread mocking a Gucci China Qixi (Chinese Valentine's Day) campaign video as looking like a cheap, low-budget short drama; a clear example of critical/mocking SNS-adjacent sentiment toward Gucci's China marketing output.

items.title: 스트레이 키즈 리노, 구찌 2026 크루즈 컬렉션 완벽 소화! 하퍼스 바자 커버 3종 공개
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Korea's November issue features three Lee Know (Stray Kids) covers styled in Gucci's 2026 Cruise collection, part of continuing ambassador content pairing the K-pop idol with the brand's seasonal lines.
